reason: The specification omits the pre-period outcome (productivity_2020), which is available, and it trims the top and bottom 1% of the outcome, so it doesn't use the full sample. It does avoid the post-period mgmt_rating_2023 control. My re-run on the full sample with productivity_2020 and the other 2020 controls gives about 0.58 (p≈0.013), which is still positive. The reported 0.627 comes from a flawed specification, so the report shouldn't be released as written.
